rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī lists Jesus as God's servant and prophet, an Israelite messenger and one of five resolute messengers with a law and Gospel, Messiah, God's Word and Spirit, imam, witness, and herald of Muhammad.
rows.anchor: كان عليه السلام عبدا لله وكان نبيا، وكان رسولا إلى بني إسرائيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He also describes Jesus as honored, near, chosen, elect, righteous, blessed, pure, a sign and mercy, dutiful to his mother, and taught scripture and wisdom.
rows.anchor: وكان وجيها في الدنيا والآخرة ومن المقربين، وكان من المصطفين، وكان من المجتبين وكان من الصالحين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These twenty-two marks of Jesus's spiritual rank divide into acquired qualities, such as servitude, nearness, and righteousness, and qualities bestowed by divine election.
rows.anchor: وهي على قسمين اكتسابية كالعبودية والقرب والصلاح، واختصاصية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an portrays Jesus as God's servant and messenger; he never claimed the status attributed to him and spoke only what God commissioned him to say.
rows.anchor: كان عبدا رسولا، وأنه لم يدع لنفسه ما نسبوه إليه، ولا تكلم معهم إلا بالرسالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus understood himself as wholly obedient to God, called people only to worship God, and served as witness to their deeds; God's final treatment of them was God's alone to decide.
rows.anchor: يرى نفسه بالنسبة إلى ربه عبدا لا شأن له إلا الامتثال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī recalls the claim that Jesus is among those who intercede and whose intercession is accepted.
rows.anchor: عيسى عليه السلام من الشفعاء يوم القيامة يشفع فيشفع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an's account of Jesus and his mother includes the statement that the crucifixion only appeared so to its observers.
rows.anchor: ولكن شبه لهم النساء 157، فهذه جمل ما قصه القرآن في عيسى ابن مريم وأمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Christians diverged into more than seventy broad sectarian positions, with many finer disputes among them.
rows.anchor: بما ربما جاوز السبعين من حيث كليات ما اختلفوا فيه، وجزئيات المذاهب والآراء كثيرة جدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an focuses on what Christians say about Jesus and his mother because those claims touch monotheism.
rows.anchor: القرآن إنما يهتم بما قالوا به في أمر عيسى نفسه وأمه لمساسه بأساس التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an gives less attention to related details such as textual corruption and redemption.
rows.anchor: وأما بعض الجزئيات كمسألة التحريف ومسألة التفدية فلم يهتم به ذاك الاهتمام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī reads Qur'an 43:86, Jesus's witness, and Qur'an 4:159 and 5:110 as supporting Jesus's intercession.
rows.anchor: ولا يملك الذين يدعون من دونه الشفاعة إلا من شهد بالحق وهم يعلمون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The account of Jesus's testimony at judgment neither establishes nor denies intercession; al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī explains why its wording does not make either case.
rows.anchor: وأما الشفاعة فالآية غير متعرضة لأمرها لا إثباتا ولا نفيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Christian redemption by substitution is distinct from intercession and would negate God's absolute sovereignty.
rows.anchor: وهذا غير التفدية التي يقول بها النصارى، وهي إبطال الجزاء بالفدية والعوض فإنها تبطل السلطنة المطلقة الإلهية

rows.speaker: النصارى
rows.claim: The Qur'an reports Christians saying that the Messiah is God's son.
rows.anchor: وقالت النصارى المسيح ابن الله

rows.speaker: النصارى
rows.claim: The Qur'an also cites the claim that the Merciful has taken a son.
rows.anchor: وقالوا اتخذ الرحمن ولدا سبحانه

rows.speaker: النصارى
rows.claim: The Qur'an reports the claim that God is the Messiah, son of Mary.
rows.anchor: لقد كفر الذين قالوا إن الله هو المسيح ابن مريم

rows.speaker: النصارى
rows.claim: The Qur'an reports the claim that God is one of three.
rows.anchor: لقد كفر الذين قالوا إن الله ثالث ثلاثة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an tells Christians to stop saying three.
rows.anchor: ولا تقولوا ثلاثة

rows.speaker: الملكانية
rows.claim: The Melkites held that Jesus was God's son in a literal sense.
rows.anchor: كمذهب الملكانية القائلين بالبنوة الحقيقية

rows.speaker: النسطورية
rows.claim: The Nestorians described descent and sonship as light shining on a transparent body like crystal.
rows.anchor: والنسطورية القائلين بأن النزول والنبوة من قبيل إشراق النور على جسم شفاف كالبلور

rows.speaker: اليعقوبية
rows.claim: The Jacobites held that God transformed into flesh and blood.
rows.anchor: واليعقوبية القائلين بأنه من الانقلاب، وقد انقلب الإله سبحانه لحما ودما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Though Christian schools differ, the Qur'an targets their common claim of Jesus's divine sonship and the related doctrine of Trinity.
rows.anchor: لكن الظاهر أن القرآن لا يهتم بخصوصيات مذاهبهم المختلفة، وإنما يهتم بكلمة واحدة مشتركة بينهم جميعا وهي البنوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The uniform Qur'anic argument shows that it addresses the shared doctrine rather than each sect's detailed formulation.
rows.anchor: والدليل على ذلك وحدة الاحتجاج الوارد عليهم في القرآن لسانا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Torah and present Gospels affirm one God, while the Gospel also states sonship and identifies the son with the Father.
rows.anchor: أن التوراة والأناجيل الحاضرة جميعا تصرح بتوحيد الإله تعالى، من جانب والإنجيل يصرح بالبنوة من جانب آخر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Christians did not read Gospel sonship as merely honorific, even though some passages explicitly use it that way.
rows.anchor: ولم يحملوا البنوة الموجودة فيه على التشريف والتبريك مع ما في موارد منه من التصريح بذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gospel passages apply the language of Father and children to Jesus's followers as well, supporting an honorific sense in some contexts.
rows.anchor: تطلق لفظ الأب على الله تعالى وتقدس بالنسبة إلى عيسى وغيره جميعا كما ترى بعناية التشريف ونحوه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other Gospel declarations present Jesus as the way to the Father, as one in the Father, and as having come from God; together with the Word passage, these appear to affirm more than honorific sonship.
rows.anchor: من رآني فقد رأى الأب فكيف تقول أنت أرنا الأب؟ أما تؤمن أني في أبي وأبي في

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Christian doctrine described here preserves Jesus as God's son while affirming one God: one substance has three hypostases, existence (Father), knowledge or Word (Son), and life (Holy Spirit); the Word descends with the Spirit.
rows.anchor: إن الذات جوهر واحد له أقانيم ثلاث، والمراد بالأقنوم هو الصفة التي هي نحو ظهور الشيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī treats the Qur'an's several descriptions of Christian belief as one shared doctrine: unity understood through Trinity, the common element across the sects.
rows.anchor: كل ذلك يرجع إلى معنى واحد وهو تثليث الوحدة هو المشترك بين جميع المذاهب المستحدثة في النصرانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an refutes Trinity by two routes: generally, showing that divine sonship is impossible; specifically, showing that Jesus is a created servant rather than God's son.
rows.anchor: يرد قول المثلثة من طريقين أحدهما الطريق العام، وهو بيان استحالة الابن عليه تعالى في نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ordinary generation divides material substance and gradually raises a new member of the same kind, so it entails materiality and developmental processes incompatible with God.
rows.anchor: حقيقة البنوة والتولد هو أن يجزأ واحد من هذه الموجودات الحية المادية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because every being depends on God, no independently existing being could match him as an equal offspring; divine generation would also imply gradual action under matter, motion, and time.
rows.anchor: فكل شيء سواه مفتقر الوجود إليه قائم الوجود به فكيف يمكن فرض شيء غيره يماثله في النوعية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī reads Qur'an 2:116–117 as separate proofs: God is exalted above offspring, all creation belongs to and obeys him, and he originates creation and brings commands to be immediately.
rows.anchor: فقوله سبحانه برهان، وقوله { له ما في السماوات والأرض كل له قانتون } برهان آخر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, “Originator of the heavens and earth” itself rules out generation because God creates without a prior model, whereas a child would reproduce its parent's likeness.
rows.anchor: ويستفاد منه أن خلقه تعالى على غير مثال سابق فلا يمكن منه الإيلاد لأنه خلق على مثال نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even if Christians mean a nonmaterial, non-temporal separation by sonship, father and son still entail real plurality: a dependent son is not God, while an independent equal would violate monotheism.
rows.anchor: إثبات الابن والأب إثبات للعدد بالضرورة، وهو إثبات للكثرة الحقيقية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qur'an 4:171 states the general argument that God is one and has no offspring.
rows.anchor: ولا تقولوا ثلاثة انتهوا خيرا لكم إنما الله إله واحد سبحانه أن يكون له ولد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus's gestation, birth, nursing, growth, aging, and ordinary bodily conditions show that he lived as a natural human and therefore was created like other people.
rows.anchor: حملت به مريم، وربته جنينا في رحمها، ثم وضعته وضع المرأة ولدها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Miracles and Jesus's birth without a father are extraordinary but possible events, not evidence of divinity; Adam and prophets also had miraculous origins or deeds without becoming divine.
rows.anchor: فإنما هي أمور خارقة للعادة المألوفة والسنة الجارية في الطبيعة فإنها نادرة الوجود لا مستحيلته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an singles out eating because it clearly proves materiality and need: hunger and thirst relieved by food and drink show dependence incompatible with divine self-sufficiency.
rows.anchor: وقد خص أكل الطعام من بين جميع الأفعال بالذكر لكونه من أحسنها دلالة على المادية واستلزاما للحاجة والفاقة المنافية للألوهية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus's human conditions were real, not appearance or imagination; the Gospels repeatedly call him human and recount ordinary bodily needs, so he could be harmed or killed like others.
rows.anchor: بل كان على الحقيقة، وكان المسيح عليه السلام إنسانا ذا هذه الأوصاف والأحوال والأفعال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an's questions about who could prevent God from killing Jesus and his mother, and whether they can control harm or benefit, reinforce that Jesus is subject to God's dominion.
rows.anchor: قل فمن يملك من الله شيئا إن أراد أن يهلك المسيح ابن مريم وأمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus's worship of God proves that he is a servant rather than God; the angels' worship similarly shows they are not divine daughters, and the Holy Spirit is not God.
rows.anchor: فعبادة المسيح أول دليل على أنه ليس بإله، وأن الألوهية لغيره لا نصيب له فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Gospels portray the Holy Spirit as obeying God and his messengers, which is incompatible with the Spirit being God commanding or obeying itself.
rows.anchor: الروح طائع لله ورسله مؤتمر للأمر محكوم بالحكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus calls the Israelites to worship God as his Lord and theirs; the Gospels likewise report that he acknowledged God as his Lord and never explicitly called people to worship himself.
rows.anchor: وقال المسيح يا بني إسرائيل اعبدوا الله ربي وربكم إنه من يشرك بالله فقد حرم الله عليه الجنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because Jesus never explicitly invited worship of himself, al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī interprets the Gospel saying “I and my Father are one” as meaning that obeying Jesus is obeying God.
rows.anchor: فمن الواجب أن يحمل على تقدير صحته على أن المراد أن اطاعتي إطاعة الله

rows.speaker: النصارى
rows.claim: Christians teach that Adam's sin and its inheritance left humanity facing eternal punishment; Christ, both divine and human and sinless, incarnated through Mary and accepted cursed crucifixion as ransom for believers and the whole world.
rows.anchor: ففدى الناس بنفسه ليخلصوا بذلك من عقاب الآخرة وهلاك السرمد وهو كفارة لخطايا المؤمنين به بل لخطايا كل العالم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī says crucifixion and redemption form the core of Christian preaching, while the Qur'an makes monotheism the foundation of Islam's call.
rows.anchor: وقد جعلت النصارى هذه الكلمة أعني مسألة الصلب والفداء أساس دعوتهم
